description: The coach's public page at tripeak.app/c/<handle>, as the Get paid dialog's Profile tab shows it: the address, whether it is published, headline, the text about their coaching, disciplines, languages and location, and the url. Before it is first saved it is a draft with an address made from their name. Athletes find the coach there, read their offers (save_offer) and apply or buy.
name: get_public_profile
